Terms of service

Last updated: 24 November 2026

These terms govern your use of the Kadar app and website. By using Kadar you agree to them.

The service

Kadar provides tools to livestream and record sports games with a scoreboard overlay. Free accounts include streaming with the scoreboard; the PRO subscription adds sponsor graphics, extra scoreboard styles, replays on air, leagues and cups, further stream destinations (TikTok, Instagram, custom RTMP), and watermark removal. The app streams to one destination at a time. Live streaming currently requires an iPhone.

Subscriptions

  • PRO is billed through the Apple App Store or Google Play as a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription, with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan.
  • Cancel any time in your store account settings; access continues until the end of the paid period. Refunds are handled by the stores under their policies.
  • Prices may change; changes apply from your next renewal and never mid-period.

Your responsibilities

  • You confirm you have the right to film and broadcast the games you stream, including any league, venue, or parental consents required where you are.
  • You retain all rights to your streams, recordings, and uploaded logos. You grant us only the technical license needed to operate the service (e.g., storing your logos and rendering them on your streams).
  • Don't use Kadar for unlawful content or to infringe others' rights, and keep your account credentials secure.

Third-party platforms

Streaming to YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram is subject to those platforms' own terms. Kadar is not affiliated with them and can't guarantee their availability or policies.

Availability and liability

We work hard to keep Kadar reliable, but livestreaming depends on your device, network, and third-party platforms, so the service is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before a claim. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under your local law, and mandatory consumer rights in your country remain unaffected.

Ending or changing the service

You can stop using Kadar and delete your account in the app at any time. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms. If we make material changes to these terms, we'll announce them here and in the app before they take effect.
